papers.title: Development of an Online Defect Detection System for Additive Manufacturing Based on Multi-Sensor Fusion
papers.abstract: Additive Manufacturing (AM), especially metal Selective Laser Melting (SLM), is essential for high-end industries like aerospace (e.g., turbine blades) and medical implants (e.g., hip implants), but in-situ defect detection remains a key bottleneck limiting its industrialization. Existing single-sensor systems fail to cover surface-subsurface-internal defects comprehensively, while traditional multi-sensor fusion suffers from information loss and poor real-time performance. This study develops an online system integrating visible light, infrared, and ultrasonic sensors, proposing a cross-modal attention-enhanced NSCT-PCNN fusion algorithm to optimize multi-modal feature fusion and an improved YOLOv3 (with an additional small-scale branch and CIoU loss) to boost detection precision. Experiments on the EOS M290 machine using Ti-6Al-4V material show the system achieves 95.8% mAP, 92.3% small defect detection rate, and 21.5 fps speed. Closed-loop control based on the system reduces the defect rate of components from 18.5% to 5.2%, and tensile strength increases by 12.3%. Future work will upgrade ultrasonic hardware and validate the system’s adaptability to multi-material AM processes.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注增材制造缺陷在线检测系统，而非Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能表征。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on defect detection system development, not on mechanical or fatigue characterization of Ti-6Al-4V; tensile strength improvement is a secondary outcome, not the primary investigation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决增材制造中单传感器无法全面检测缺陷的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出集成可见光、红外和超声传感器的跨模态注意力融合算法及改进YOLOv3。
summary_zh.result: 系统缺陷检测mAP达95.8%，闭环控制使构件缺陷率从18.5%降至5.2%。
summary_zh.validation: 在EOS M290上用Ti-6Al-4V进行了实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the limitation of single-sensor systems in comprehensive defect detection during additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Developed an online system fusing visible, infrared, and ultrasonic sensors with a cross-modal attention-enhanced NSCT-PCNN fusion algorithm and an improved YOLOv3 detector.
summary_en.result: The system achieved 95.8% mAP, 92.3% detection rate for small defects, and reduced component defect rate from 18.5% to 5.2% via closed-loop control.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was conducted on an EOS M290 machine using Ti-6Al-4V material.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了基于Ti-6Al-4V的氧化物弥散强化合金的增材制造，可能提供新材料的力学性能数据。
llm.why_not_core: No fatigue data or S-N curves reported; focus is on strength and hardness rather than fatigue life.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过氧化物弥散强化提升Ti-6Al-4V合金的力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用原位氧化物分散粉末和粘结剂金属沉积增材制造技术。
summary_zh.result: 制备出具有高强度和高硬度的氧化物弥散强化Ti-6Al-4V合金。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构和力学测试验证了强化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V alloy through oxide dispersion strengthening.
summary_en.method: An in-situ oxide-dispersed powder approach combined with bound metal deposition additive manufacturing.
summary_en.result: A Ti-6Al-4V based oxide dispersion strengthened alloy with improved strength and hardness was fabricated.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization and mechanical testing confirmed the strengthening effect.
